about: The introitus of the formulary “Saints Peter and Paul, Apostles” in the 1962 Roman Missal.

seg.tr: Now I know truly that the Lord has sent His angel and has rescued me from the hand of Herod and from all the expectation of the Jewish people. O Lord, You have tested me and known me; You have known my sitting down and my rising up. Glory be to the Father, and to the Son, and to the Holy Spirit. As it was in the beginning, is now, and ever shall be, world without end. Amen. Now I know truly that the Lord has sent His angel and has rescued me from the hand of Herod and from all the expectation of the Jewish people.
